visuals.color.notes: Palette fixed by the owner on 2026-10-09, derived from the iMoles HF prototypes: brand hue 225° (brand.600 #00698C), neutrals in the brand hue, crimson #DB2149 (high risk), amber #8D6F00 (intermediate), light teal #168072 (low), plum #6C2768 (not assessable); coral, green and violet removed. All four levels use a solid fill with white text and a tint with dark text from their family. Contrast validated against WCAG 2.2 (all listed pairs pass). Color-vision differences recorded as ΔE OKLab in normal vision, deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia and achromatopsia; by decision of the owner, pairs below 8 are covered by badge shape and text (WCAG 1.4.1). Interaction values approved by the owner on 2026-10-10 (hover step 650, pressed 700, surfaces neutral.25/100, focus ring brand.600, disabled neutral.150/600, scrim neutral.950 at 48%). Token format for the future DS implementation, outside this repo: W3C DTCG. Token names in English, confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-10. Corrections the iMoles prototype needs to adopt this palette are listed on the page and kept as tasks in implementation.publishing-and-migration; they are iMoles work, not work of this section. Stays in I: no recorded review.
